Part-Time Social Media Content Manager and Designer

**Company:** 440 Strategy Group  
**Hours:** Approximately 20 hours per week  
**Location:** Remote (US based), with availability during U.S. business hours

440 Strategy Group is seeking an experienced Social Media Content Manager and Designer to support multiple client brands, primarily dental and healthcare practices. This role combines creative content planning, copywriting, graphic design, short-form video editing, and direct client communication. Reporting to the business owner, this person will manage the full content process from monthly planning through approval and publication.

Responsibilities

- Develop monthly content calendars with 12-16 posts per client, incorporating educational, promotional, seasonal, and practice-specific content.
- Write engaging post captions, image headlines, supporting copy, calls to action, and relevant hashtags.
- Design modern, professional graphics, carousels, stories, and reusable templates using Canva.
- Create and edit short-form videos for social media, including Reels, Shorts, and TikToks, using client-provided footage, photos, and other assets.
- Work within each client's brand standards, colors, fonts, and visual style.
- Adapt copy and creative for the appropriate social media platforms.
- Communicate directly with clients to gather content, review monthly packages, incorporate feedback, and obtain approvals.
- Manage one-off requests and additional posts while maintaining monthly production deadlines.
- Schedule approved content through SocialPilot and verify publication.
- Maintain project schedules, deadlines, and status updates in Asana, and organize creative assets in Google Drive.
- Proactively bring fresh content ideas, design approaches, and recommendations to leadership.
- Participate in brief weekly internal meetings and client content reviews as needed.

Qualifications

- At least five years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong social media portfolio.
- Advanced Canva skills and a strong understanding of typography, layout, branding, and modern design.
- Excellent social media copywriting skills and the ability to write for U.S. audiences across multiple brand voices.
- Experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools to develop and refine social media copy, with sound editorial judgment to ensure accuracy, natural language, and consistency with each client's brand voice.
- Demonstrated ability to edit engaging social media videos using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Canva, or comparable tools.
- Experience planning content calendars and managing multiple client brands.
- Strong organizational, proofreading, and client communication skills.
- A self-driven, entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to work independently, solve problems, and proactively contribute ideas.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of creative quality and deadlines.
- Experience with SocialPilot or similar scheduling platforms, plus familiarity with Asana, Slack, and Google Drive.
- Healthcare or dental marketing experience and Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator skills are a plus.

To Apply

Please provide a resume or summary of your relevant experience and a portfolio that includes social media designs, two to three short-form videos, and examples of captions or other social copy you have written. Include a sample monthly content calendar or completed content package, and briefly identify your role in planning, writing, designing, or editing the work. Please also share your availability and compensation expectations.

Pay: $2,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
  
  
As a Senior Content Designer, you like being at the intersection of content and design. You understand that content that's well designed is easy to follow and understandable. As a champion for our users, you organize and present content in a meaningful way.
  
  
You will draw upon your knowledge of content, design and UX best practices, brand guidelines, accessibility standards and competitive research to simplify the user experience. You will collaborate with designers, researchers, product managers, engineering and other stakeholders with occasional direct support from your manager. You may also be called upon to mentor junior colleagues. When you have to show your work, you’ll love the chance to participate and run workshops and design crits.
  
  
**Experience**

- 5+ years experience in UX writing , UX Design or Content Design
- 2+ years experience with Agile and lean UX/software development practices, including using product management software (Rally, Jira)
- 2+ years experience in web and app experiences
- 2+ years experience collaborating with internal team members, such as experience designers, accessibility experts  and product managers
- 2+ years experience in UX wire framing, UX flows, and shaping content for multi-disciplinary projects with prototyping software such as Figma and Miro
- Experience in health care, pharmacy or other regulated fields (insurance, finance, etc.)
- Experience with translation and transcreation best practices
- Deep knowledge of enterprise content management systems such as Adobe Experience Manager, Contentful, or similar
- Portfolio should include work on digital products and/or services, service design or human centered designs

**Basic Qualifications**

- Extensive experience with design software (Figma, Airtable, InVision, Miro)
- Experience with AI tools (Claude-Code, Claude integration with MCPs, FigmaMake, etc.)
- Experience collaborating across disciplines (design, design ops, research and usability, accessibility, product managers and engineering)
- Experience in working with and improving business requirements
- Comfortable with UX and Usability terminology, taxonomies and practices, including Design Thinking and Human-Centered Design methods, to solve problems and innovate
- Knows how and when to use inventories and audits, content frameworks, competitive analysis and mapping
- Knows when to collaborate and compromise and when to be the voice for the user and stand up for what’s right.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Translate complex concepts and processes into compelling, easy-to-follow design with exceptional content.
- Conduct UX research and champion data science to understand user behaviors and uncover new opportunities to reach customers with appropriate content and reduce friction.
- Create content and design ecosystems for multiple channels, devices and touch points across user journey flows, meeting user needs and adhering to enterprise standards.
- Challenge the status quo and know when to advocate for new design patterns versus relying on old systems.
- Drive collaboration with designers, product managers, and diverse business stakeholders to inform requirements to think beyond the product lifecycle and optimize content and user journey.
- Lead other content strategists/designers in developing user stories and providing guidance on priorities.
- Facilitate workshops and design crits and own content reviews and iterations across stakeholders from product to legal.

**Education**

- Bachelor or master's degree preferred in the field of Human Computer Interaction, Information Architecture, Technical Writing, English, or Journalism.  Extensive work experience, academic work or certifications in user experience fields are also welcome.

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**
40
  
  
**Time Type**
Full time
  
  
**Pay Range**
**The Typical Pay Range For This Role Is**
$54,300.00 - $145,860.00
  
  
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.
  
  
Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.
  
  
**Great Benefits For Great People**
We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.
  
  
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.
  
  
Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.
  
  
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/23/2026
  
  
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Job Type

Full-time

Description

Fervo is working to build the most cost-effective, repeatable geothermal power plants in the world. Delivering on this mission requires compelling, high-quality communication across every channel. Joining Fervo's Communications team means shaping the public narrative of a fast-growing clean energy company, raising the visibility of our work as we reinvent how geothermal energy is delivered at scale. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, investors, and developers in making geothermal a key pillar of our climate-friendly energy future.

We are seeking a Media and Editorial Content Lead to own Fervo's relationship with the press, and manage an integrated content strategy for its digital channels. This role is the front line for every inbound media inquiry and the driver behind proactive outreach that puts Fervo's story in front of the right audiences.

The Media and Editorial Content Lead manages all media relations for Fervo, end to end — fielding inbound press inquiries, proactively pitching outbound stories, building and maintaining reporter relationships, and drafting the press releases and statements that carry Fervo's name. This role also owns Fervo's social media presence, setting the day-to-day voice and content strategy across the company's channels, including its website.

This role requires someone comfortable operating fast and independently, equally capable of handling a reporter's same-day request and planning a proactive media and social calendar weeks out. As a newly public company, Fervo's media presence matters, and this role is expected to exercise sound judgment on what gets said, when and where, and to what audiences. Exemplary writing and storytelling is a must for this role.

Requirements

***Responsibilities***

*Media Relations*

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all inbound media inquiries, coordinating responses with the head of communications, agency teams and leadership as needed
- Drive proactive outbound media outreach, pitching stories and securing coverage that supports Fervo's narrative and builds a positive reputation for the company.
- Build and maintain relationships with reporters, editors, and outlets covering energy, climate, and technology
- Draft press releases, holding statements, FAQs and media briefing materials
- Track and report on media coverage and sentiment

*Social Media & Digital Channels*

- Own Fervo's social media channels end to end, including content strategy, calendar, and day-to-day posting
- Manage paid social across platforms
- Set and maintain a consistent brand voice across all social platforms
- Monitor social engagement and adjust strategy based on what resonates with Fervo's audiences
- Align all editorial content with broader company strategy

*Crisis & Issues Support*

- Support rapid-response communications during breaking news, incidents, or issues affecting Fervo's reputation
- Help prepare holding statements and messaging guidance for use across media and social channels

***Qualifications***

*Required*

- 5+ years of experience in media relations or public relations, in-house or agency
- Established relationships with reporters and outlets covering energy, climate, or technology
- Experience drafting high impact communications like news releases, statements and digital content.
- Experience owning and growing a company's social media presence across major platforms
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to move quickly and make sound judgment calls under time pressure
- Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field

*Preferred*

- Experience in energy, climate tech, or another regulated industry
- Experience with media monitoring and social analytics tools
- Crisis communications experience
- Experience supporting media relations at a newly public company

***Location***

Fervo Energy is headquartered in Houston, TX, with growing offices in Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. This position is eligible for some hybrid work flexibility, but regular in-office presence at the **Houston** office is required. Some travel is required for this position.

**About MooniPet:**

MooniPet is a modern pet-care and lifestyle brand building a playful visual world around pets, education, storytelling, and the human-animal bond.

We are developing original characters, including Moojy & Goojy, alongside educational and entertainment-driven content designed for social media and future brand extensions.

Our visual direction is imaginative, expressive, modern, slightly magical, and character-led.

We are looking for someone who can help turn that world into a recognizable visual identity.

**Who We’re Looking For:**

We’re looking for a highly creative illustrator and visual content designer who can take ideas, characters, and educational concepts and turn them into engaging, visually distinctive social content.

The ideal person is first and foremost a strong visual creative who understands illustration, character design, composition, storytelling, and brand aesthetics, while also understanding how content needs to work on Instagram and other social platforms.

You should be comfortable developing characters, creating original artwork, designing educational posts, adapting illustrations into social formats, and helping build a consistent visual universe around the MooniPet brand.

What You’ll Create

**You will work on projects such as:**

\* Illustrating and developing Moojy & Goojy and other MooniPet characters

\* Creating original character poses, expressions, outfits, situations, and environments

\* Designing Instagram posts, carousels, Stories, covers, and visual campaigns

\* Turning veterinary and pet-care information into engaging illustrated educational content

\* Creating playful pet-related illustrations, comics, mini-stories, and visual concepts

\* Developing recurring visual formats and recognizable content series

\* Creating branded graphics that feel consistent with MooniPet’s visual identity

\* Helping define the visual world, personality, and style of MooniPet characters

\* Translating rough ideas, sketches, references, or creative direction into polished artwork

\* Adapting artwork for different social and digital formats

\* Occasionally supporting simple motion, animation concepts, or short-form visual assets

**We are especially interested in candidates who have experience with:**

\* Character illustration

\* Character development and expression sheets

\* Digital painting and drawing

\* Cartoon or stylized illustration

\* Editorial or educational illustration

\* Visual storytelling

\* Social media design

\* Composition, typography, and layout

\* Creating a consistent visual style across multiple pieces of content

*A strong portfolio matters more to us than a specific degree.*

**TL;DR:**
We’re looking for a Content Lead to turn complex AI safety topics into clear, compelling stories that build trust, shape White Circle’s voice, and drive product adoption. You’ll own content end-to-end: find the story, define the angle, write it, publish it, and make sure it reaches the right technical audience.
  
  
**About White Circle**
White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.
  
  

- We’ve recently raised our Series A funding round of $70M (total funding of $81M) from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others
- We process over one hundred million API calls every month
- We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

- Own White Circle's content vision and editorial direction
- Turn customer conversations into case studies, customer stories, and reference materials
- Write and publish long-form content across Medium, Substack, LinkedIn, X, and our website
- Develop technical and non-technical content explaining AI safety, evaluation, governance, and reliability
- Create launch narratives for new products, features, and research initiatives
- Partner closely with product, as well as supporting wider business teams where needed
- Help founders maintain a consistent public voice across LinkedIn, X, conferences, and other channels
- Build repeatable processes for content creation, publication, and distribution
- Experiment with new formats, channels, and ways of reaching technical audience

**We're looking for someone who**

- Is an exceptional writer
- Can take a complex technical topic and explain it clearly without oversimplifying it
- Knows how to find interesting stories inside products, customers, and technology
- Has strong editorial judgment
- Can independently identify what is worth publishing and what isn't
- Has experience creating content for technical audiences
- Can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on writing
- Is fluent in English

**A big plus**

- You have an engineering, computer science, or technical background
- You have built an audience through writing
- You have a track record of making technical topics compelling, whether at a developer tools or AI company, in tech journalism, or through your own writing and audience
- You've written content that materially influenced product adoption, company positioning, or revenue generation

****Compensation & benefits****

- Competitive compensation package, including equity
- Flexible time off
- Health insurance
- Mental health support, including coverage for therapy when you need it
- 401(k) retirement plan
- Learning and development support for courses, conferences, and opportunities to grow your skills
- All the hardware, subscriptions, tools, and services you need
- Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Marbella

**How We Hire**

- Intro call with Talent (25 min)
- Take-home assignment
- Final conversation with our CEO and Head of Design & Creative (45 min)
- An additional interview with one or more team members may be added depending on the interview process

***Along with your application, please send us 3 pieces of writing you're most proud of and tell us why you chose them.***

data.description:
# **We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew.**

# **Senior Editorial Writer**

# **ModSquad | Marketing | Contractor/Freelancer**

  
  
  

## ***About the Role***

ModSquad is executing a brand-led marketing strategy. We're looking for a contract editorial writer who covers our category the way a trade journalist or industry analyst would – someone who already knows the outsourced customer support trust & safety landscape, and follows what the vendors and platforms are actually doing.

This is not a content marketing role. We're looking for someone who can interview our executives, read the industry data critically, surface the stories buried inside our client work, and shape all of it into pieces that people running digital operations actually want to read – published under our leaders' names and placed with the publications their peers already read.

If you've covered this beat at a trade publication, worked as an industry analyst, built original research that others cited, or ghostwritten executive bylines that didn't sound like press releases, we should talk.

  

## ***What You'll Do***

## **Editorial & Executive Voice**

- Ghostwrite executive articles for owned, social, and external distribution channels
- Interview internal SMEs, clients, and partners to extract story angles and original perspectives
- Develop sponsored editorial and co-authored pieces for targeted trade publishers
- Support live programming – office hours, panel appearances, recurring conversations with senior ModSquad voices – including prep, framing, and turning recordings into written pieces

## **Research & Category Analysis**

- Track the CX, trust & safety, moderation, and outsourcing landscape – competitor positioning, vendor claims, analyst coverage, regulatory movement – and tell us where our point of view has room to land
- Build data-led editorial: original surveys, benchmark analyses, state-of-the-industry pieces, and commentary grounded in real numbers
- Read industry research critically and translate it into an argument a practitioner can use
Identify the stories our competitors are not telling  

  

**Client Storytelling**

- Partner with Account Management and Sales to identify client stories worth telling
- Develop anonymized or attributed client stories that are specific and authentic, not templated
Build a repeatable process for sourcing, quantifying, and clearing client stories – including getting to business outcomes, not just a list of services delivered  

  

## ***What We're Looking For***

  

**Experience**

- Demonstrated experience covering or analyzing at least one of: customer experience, contact centers, BPO/outsourcing, trust & safety, content moderation, enterprise SaaS, or digital operations
- A track record in journalism, trade publishing, industry analysis, or research writing – not general content marketing
- Demonstrable executive ghostwriting, with published examples
Experience producing or interpreting original research – surveys, benchmark data, industry datasets  

  

**Skills**

- You can pull a story out of a 30-minute conversation with a busy executive
- You can take a pile of ideas or a rough brief and build a coherent, logical argument
- You know how trade publications work: pitching editorial angles, sponsored content, co-authorship, and when each is the right call
- You can name the publications, newsletters, and analysts that matter in this category
- Comfortable in plain text workflows, Markdown, and GitHub
- You know how to diagram a sentence, apply the Paramedic Method from Revising Prose, or have read Several Short Sentences About Writing more than once and have thoughts about how to apply it editorially
- You're allergic to AI slop
You're already thinking about how to improve this job description  

  

**Mindset**

- Operates with editorial judgment, not just execution; pushes back when a brief doesn't have a story yet
- Fast and self-directed; sets their own production pace without heavy oversight
Comfortable working as an independent contractor alongside an in-house team  

  

## **Compensation & Structure**

- This engagement is structured as an independent contractor arrangement and does not include employee benefits.
- The initial engagement will run for six months, with the possibility of extension based on business needs and project volume.
- The engagement is fully remote. Some availability during Pacific business hours may be needed for executive interviews and live programming; otherwise, the contractor may perform the services asynchronously.
- The contractor will work with the Content & Creative Production team and collaborate with the Head of Brand and VP of Marketing.
- Services will be requested on an as-needed basis, and weekly hours may vary depending on project volume.
- Compensation will be paid hourly. The contractor will track time through Teambridge Systems and submit monthly invoices for services performed.
All work product created under the engagement will be subject to the intellectual property and work-product provisions of the contractor agreement.  

**Location Restrictions**

U.S. Candidates: This engagement is not available to individuals who will perform services from New York City, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey. Contractors must perform services from an eligible U.S. location outside those jurisdictions for the duration of the engagement.

  

***How To Apply***

**Send us:**

- **Two writing samples that were published under someone else's name – an executive byline, a ghostwritten article, a placed piece. Tell us the outlet and roughly when. If the work is confidential, an anonymized version or a description of the engagement is fine; we understand ghostwriting is often unattributable.**
- **One sample under your own byline – ideally something reported, analytical, or data-driven**
- **A cover letter. We strongly encourage one. You're a writer, right? Write.**

***On AI: The cover letter and samples should be yours and we will be reading for that.***

  

*ModSquad is a fully remote company. We support clients in customer experience, content moderation, trust & safety, and digital engagement.*

  

*ModSquad is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, military status, status as a veteran or disabled veteran, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, genetic information, medical condition, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.*

  

*Individual base pay depends on various factors, in addition to primary work location, such as complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. Although we have opportunities across the globe, this advertisement excludes individuals residing in California, Colorado, New York, and Washington at this time.*
